name: Director Sportif
description: Race calls and pack meters for Zwift, built on measured Zwift physics: what your spot in the pack costs (Position), watts you spend for nothing (Holding, Blocked), the gap and left/right to the wheel, and spoken calls for the pack, climbs, the finish and power-ups. Records your rides for a free report at caffecter.com, and can run OBS with the race.
author: PaulCurtis5227

windows.name: Director Sportif
windows.description: Runs the Director Sportif: one line of what to do now (the call and the meters' advice), Record and Mark. Keep it open: the Grid shows its meters (settings: the gear; right-click the window to show it)
